query: Scheduled exports are stuck in a worker backlog and report downloads are late.
label_reason: The export queue blockage and delayed downloads match the past export-worker case.

query: Newly published untagged products cannot be found while browsing categories.
label_reason: Untagged new catalog items missing from category pages match the indexer case.

query: Localized catalog filters display counts from another language setting.
label_reason: Locale-specific facet counts match the cache-key case.

query: A promotion seems to subtract the same discount two times at checkout.
label_reason: The double promotion discount matches the deduplication case.

query: Guest shoppers cannot submit a local-format telephone number.
label_reason: Guest-only phone validation matches the checkout validator case.

query: A charge was authorized but the payment page still says pending.
label_reason: Pending status after authorization matches the callback-consumer case.

query: Repeating a timed-out card attempt creates two temporary authorization holds.
label_reason: Duplicate holds after retry match the idempotency-key case.

query: Members of one company fail single sign-on because the audience is wrong.
label_reason: The tenant-specific SSO audience mismatch matches the cached mapping case.

query: Users with two open tabs get trapped in a sign-in refresh loop.
label_reason: Concurrent refresh and login loop match the session-race case.

query: Abandoned baskets continue to reserve stock long after they expire.
label_reason: Expired stock reservations after cart abandonment match the scheduler case.

query: Preorder items are presented as immediately available inventory.
label_reason: A missing preorder flag matches the availability-badge case.

query: Customers receive account notifications in a language they did not choose.
label_reason: Wrong notification language matches the template-cache case.

query: Alerts arrive during quiet hours when daylight saving time changes.
label_reason: Daylight transition and quiet hours match the fixed-offset scheduler case.

query: Searching with diacritics misses products that should match.
label_reason: Accent normalization mismatch matches the search-analyzer case.

query: The second page of search results repeats the first page.
label_reason: Repeated pagination results match the cursor-decoding case.

query: Large multipart file uploads fail checksum validation at the end.
label_reason: Multipart assembly and checksum failure match the part-sort case.

query: A shared file URL breaks when its name contains spaces.
label_reason: Spaces in shared upload links match the double-encoding case.

query: Dashboard charts are one day behind despite new events arriving.
label_reason: Stale analytics charts match the watermark-before-commit case.

query: Downloaded CSV report columns shift when free text contains commas.
label_reason: Delimiter handling in report exports matches the CSV quoting case.

query: Invoice PDF files render with empty pages for some accounts.
label_reason: Blank invoice PDFs match the optional-footer rendering case.

query: Changing a subscription plan gives inconsistent prorated cost previews.
label_reason: Plan-change estimate drift matches the proration-version case.
